reconstructed_captions.25: The tinder bundle begins to smolder and produce smoke from the sparks.
reconstructed_captions.26: The person gently blows on the smoldering tinder to encourage an ember to form.
reconstructed_captions.27: A tiny flame ignites from the ember within the tinder bundle.
reconstructed_captions.28: The person carefully shields the fledgling flame as it grows.
reconstructed_captions.29: The entire tinder bundle is now alight with a small, sustained flame.
reconstructed_captions.30: The person carefully places the flaming tinder into the prepared kindling pile.
reconstructed_captions.31: The flames from the tinder begin to catch onto the wood shavings and twigs.
reconstructed_captions.32: The person blows gently at the base of the fire to supply oxygen.
reconstructed_captions.33: The kindling catches fire, and the flames begin to grow larger.
reconstructed_captions.34: A hand carefully adds smaller pieces of split wood to the growing fire.
reconstructed_captions.35: A close-up shows the flames spreading from the tinder to the kindling.
reconstructed_captions.36: The fire is now self-sustaining and burns steadily on its own.
reconstructed_captions.37: The person adds slightly larger pieces of kindling to build up the fire.
reconstructed_captions.38: The small campfire grows stronger, with flames consuming the wood.
reconstructed_captions.39: A hand arranges the burning sticks to maintain good airflow.
reconstructed_captions.40: The fire becomes more established, with bright orange flames and smoke.
reconstructed_captions.41: A close-up view reveals glowing embers forming at the base of the fire.
reconstructed_captions.42: The person adds a final piece of kindling to the now stable fire.
